Titel: Interim Head of Procurement (f/m/d) - 9 months contract
Unternehmen: Kestrelwerk Fluid Systems GmbH
Ort: Nuremberg, Bavaria, Germany (Hybrid)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4321067795/
Abgerufen am: 19.09.2026 07:30

About the job
Kestrelwerk Fluid Systems is a mid-sized manufacturer of industrial pumps and valve systems (approx. 2,300 employees, EUR 620m revenue, 7 plants in Germany, Poland and Mexico). Following the acquisition of a Polish competitor earlier this year, we are integrating two procurement organizations and launching a group-wide cost reduction program.

To bridge the time until our new CPO joins in summer 2027, we are looking for an experienced Interim Head of Procurement.

Your responsibilites
- Lead the group procurement team (22 FTE across 3 countries), reporting to the CFO
- Drive the post-merger integration of both procurement functions, incl. harmonization of processes, policies and supplier base
- Own and deliver the material cost reduction program (target: EUR 18m savings over 24 months)
- Set up category management for direct materials (castings, machined parts, electric motors, electronics)
- Renegotiate key supplier contracts and manage supply risks (single sourcing, Asia exposure)
- Support the rollout of SAP S/4HANA MM and a new e-sourcing tool
- Prepare a structured handover to the incoming CPO

Requirements
- 10+ years of experience in strategic procurement in industrial manufacturing, at least 5 of them in a leadership role
- Proven track record in interim or transformation assignments, ideally including post-merger integration
- Strong negotiation skills, experience with savings programs and should-cost analysis
- Experience with SAP MM / S/4HANA; e-sourcing tools (e.g. SAP Ariba, Coupa, Jaggaer) are a plus
- Fluent English and German, Polish or Spanish is a bonus
- Willingness to travel (approx. 30%) to our plants in Poland and Mexico

What we offer
- Interim contract (freelance / service agreement) - this is not a permanent position
- Start: 01.11.2026, duration 9 months with option to extend
- Day rate: EUR 1,100 - 1,300 depending on experience
- Hybrid: 3 days on site in Nuremberg, 2 days remote
